name: straykeys
description: Check YAML and JSON config files against the Go struct they decode into, and find keys the program silently ignores: typos, wrong case, keys at the wrong level, renamed fields, durations without units, and values the decoder refuses. Supports gopkg.in/yaml.v3, encoding/json, sigs.k8s.io/yaml, viper and koanf, and configs inside Kubernetes ConfigMaps.
